party_and_route_bookkeeper.agent_description: Tracks party statistics (levels, HP, PP, moves), inventory, current funds, and defeated trainers on each route/area.
party_and_route_bookkeeper.agent_system_prompt: You are a specialized party and route bookkeeping assistant for a Pokémon Blue playthrough with a Crystal palette mod. Your job is to process updates to party status, inventory, money, and trainer defeat status, and output a structured, updated summary of the player's adventure state. Keep track of: Party Pokémon: Name, Level, current HP/max HP, moves and their current PP, status conditions; Inventory items and quantities; Defeated trainers by map; Current money. Provide clean, markdown-ready updates.
party_and_route_bookkeeper.agent_input_schema: {"type": "object", "properties": {"action": {"type": "string", "description": "The type of update to process (e.g. 'battle_defeat', 'heal_party', 'buy_items', 'use_item', 'trainer_defeated')"}, "details": {"type": "string", "description": "Details of the update, such as moves used, PP changes, items used, or trainer name and coordinates."}}, "required": ["action", "details"]}
party_and_route_bookkeeper.agent_output_schema: {"type": "object", "properties": {"updated_bookkeeping_state": {"type": "string", "description": "A fully updated, structured markdown block detailing the current party stats, inventory, funds, and defeated trainers."}}, "required": ["updated_bookkeeping_state"]}
